pois.label: 高温散热板阵（600 K · 624 板）
pois.detail: 聚变电站 585 MW 废热的最终去处：26 列 × 12 行共 312 组 V 形支架、624 块 15 m × 5 m 高温散热板，工质把热量携至板内、以热辐射抛向天空。白天是一片近黑色的地毯，夜里板面泛出 600 K 的暗红余晖——城北最大的单体设施，比电站本身大一个数量级。
pois.detail_en: The final destination for the fusion plant's 585 MW of waste heat: 26 columns x 12 rows - 312 V-frames carrying 624 panels of 15 m x 5 m - where the working fluid brings heat into the panels and radiates it to the sky. By day a near-black carpet, by night the faces glow the dull red of 600 K. It is the largest single structure in the north of the city, an order of magnitude bigger than the plant itself.
sim: 辐射平衡校验：双面辐射 2×46,800 m² × ε0.9 × σ × (600⁴−210⁴) K⁴ ≈ 610 MW ≥ 585 MW，设计闭合（火星天空有效温度 ~210 K，背景回辐射仅 ~1.9%）
为什么敢用 600 K 高温回路：辐射功率 ∝ T⁴，若降到 300 K 排同样的热需 16 倍板面（~75 万 m²）——高温回路是火星大功率排热唯一现实解
火星特有：大气 0.6 kPa，对流散热占比 <2%，辐射独挑大梁；无雨无氧，裸板免蚀，尘降靠 35° 倾角自清
跨资产订正（pwr-grid-01 台账）：610 MW ≥ 585 MW 的校核未计板面太阳吸收——计入后晴天洁净 606 MW、积尘 597 MW（余量 2%）。反直觉：积尘在晴天咬人、尘暴期反而缓解（日照塌了）。散热板清洗因此是一项电网可用性事项，不只是保养。
sim_en: Radiative balance check: two-sided radiation, 2 x 46,800 m2 x epsilon 0.9 x sigma x (600^4 - 210^4) K^4 ~ 610 MW >= 585 MW, so the design closes (Martian sky effective temperature ~210 K, background back-radiation only ~1.9%).

Why dare a 600 K loop: radiated power scales as T^4, so dropping to 300 K would need 16x the panel area (~7.5e5 m2) to reject the same heat - a high-temperature loop is the only realistic answer for high-power heat rejection on Mars.

Mars-specific: at 0.6 kPa convection carries under 2% of the load, so radiation does all the work; with no rain and no oxygen the bare panels do not corrode, and the 35 deg tilt sheds settling dust on its own.

Cross-asset correction (pwr-grid-01 ledger): the 610 vs 585 MW check omitted solar absorptance - with it, a clean field rejects 606 MW on a clear day and a dusty one 597 MW (2% margin). Counterintuitively dust bites on clear days and relents in storms, when insolation collapses. Radiator cleaning is therefore a grid-availability item, not mere housekeeping.

pois.label: 冷却工质母管
pois.detail: 贯穿全场 430 m 的热供/冷回两根母管，向 12 行板排分支供液；西端跨接管接向电站换热器。管径与流速按温降 ~100 K 配平——工质进场 650 K、出场 550 K，板面平均 600 K 即取此中值。
pois.detail_en: Two headers - hot supply and cold return - run the full 430 m of the field, branching to the 12 panel rows; a crossover at the west end ties into the plant heat exchanger. Bore and flow are balanced for a ~100 K drop: the fluid enters at 650 K and leaves at 550 K, and the 600 K panel average is the midpoint of the two.

specs_en.Headers: hot supply + cold return, 0.6 m dia

pois.label: 警示桅杆（18 m）
pois.detail: 板阵最高点仅 5 m，从远处看是一块难以辨认的暗色地毯——两端 18 m 桅杆顶着红色闪光信标，为低空飞行器和地面车队标出这片 430 m × 110 m 禁入区的边界。板面 600 K，误入的代价是实打实的。
pois.detail_en: The array tops out at just 5 m, reading from a distance as an indistinct dark carpet - so an 18 m mast at each end carries a red flashing beacon, marking the edge of this 430 m x 110 m keep-out zone for low-flying craft and ground convoys. The panels are at 600 K; the cost of wandering in is very real.
